_doc: G3: static/native-tier components that have no cascivo-html emitter or parity case yet. Key: unit name. The list may only shrink: an entry whose component gained an emitter, case and PARITY_COMPONENTS row fails as stale.

entries.code-snippet: Copy-to-clipboard button and highlighted code need client JS; a static emitter would drop the behaviour that defines the component.
entries.indicator: Positions an arbitrary child through a slot; the .cv language has no slot-in-slot syntax for the overlay yet.
entries.inline-citation: Hover card content is composed by the host app from source data; markup depends on a runtime lookup, not on .cv input.
entries.input-group: Wraps a caller-supplied input element; emitting it needs the compound-child grammar planned with the form emitters.
entries.qr-code: SVG is produced by a JS encoder; porting the encoder to Rust is its own task, not a markup emitter.
entries.relative-time: Renders a phrase from the current clock and locale; a static page would freeze it, and the live update is JS behaviour.
